cover_headline: Jailer 2 First Indian Film to Cross Rs 75 Crore in All Four South Markets

end.headline: Jailer 2 First Indian Film to Cross Rs 75 Crore in All Four South Markets
end.line: Rajinikanth's sequel completed the milestone in Kerala on its 16th day, finishing a four-market run that eluded Baahubali 2, KGF Chapter 2 and Pushpa 2, according to Sacnilk.

facts: Jailer 2 has become the first Indian film to gross over Rs 75 crore individually in each of the four major South Indian markets, according to Sacnilk
Kerala was the last market to cross, reaching Rs 75.20 crore on day 16; the four markets together contributed Rs 454.75 crore
Worldwide, Sacnilk puts the film at Rs 776.95 crore after 16 days, including Rs 267.50 crore overseas
